q: A subshift of finite type (SFT) is defined by forbidding a finite list of words. Its topological entropy equals:
opts: The growth rate of the number of admissible words: log of the spectral radius of the adjacency matrix
The logarithm of the alphabet size
Infinity if the shift has fixed points
exp: For an SFT defined by a vertex or edge shift with adjacency matrix A, the topological entropy is log ρ(A), where ρ(A) is the spectral radius (Perron eigenvalue of A).
